task.name: 01-models-and-filesystem-adapter
task.summary: Implemented Stage 1 typed models, explicit configuration, application operations, and atomic filesystem publication with descending catalogue pagination.

deviations.summary: Shared model field constraints reside in models/fields.ts; each model retains its own checks and there is no independent validation pipeline.
deviations.resolution: Common canonical UUID, UTC timestamp, and record-shape checks are underlying model artifacts.

deviations.summary: Selected explicit {{graphic:identifier}} references and signature identification for PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP.
deviations.resolution: Documented the producer/renderer convention and configured supported formats; storage never transforms text.

deviations.summary: Used the native Node TypeScript test runner and added @types/node instead of a separate test framework.
deviations.resolution: npm run test:persistence executes isolated tests and is included in the unchanged existing quality-check sequence.

changes.change: One file per model; configured Unicode limits, canonical identifiers/timestamps, explicit graphic tokens, MIME identification and SHA-256 checks.
Required settings with no fallbacks, configuration-relative storage root, explicit absolute override, and independent test settings.
Complete-bundle checks, application-owned Registry timestamp from an explicit clock, logical duplicate comparison and typed failures.
upstream_impact: Future publication CLI and Astro consumers

changes.change: Private staging, exclusive record installation, atomic catalogue replacement, scoped failure cleanup, fresh catalogue-only listing, registered complete reads and store-local identity conflict detection.

46 isolated tests cover configured constraints, exact round trips, retries, conflicts, descending cursors, read restrictions, integrity failures, atomic visibility and cleanup failures; Node types added.
Reconciled approved pagination/configuration changes and documented implemented Stage 1 behavior and later-stage boundaries.

changes.responsibility: Reusable library toolboxes and descriptive constants
changes.change: Applied all 13 user review remarks: extracted string, array, record-map, binary, and MIME utilities; replaced repeated predicates; named regular expressions, supported MIME list, configuration keys and model field lists. Preserved whitespace content semantics and existing signature detection.

changes.responsibility: Domain nonempty strings and shared persistence checks
changes.change: Added isNonEmptyString for content and summaries, reject blank summaries, exported model field constants and imported them into the service. Moved requested catalogue/envelope/media-shape/association checks into service functions invoked by the filesystem adapter. Updated summary specification and configuration descriptions.

baseline.summary: Seven pre-existing formatting failures: planning skill, both persistence specifications and all four approved plan files. Unrelated working-tree edits were identified and preserved.

targeted.summary: 46 tests passed on Node v25.4.0, all using isolated temporary roots.
Astro/type checks: zero errors, warnings or hints.
Production build passed; existing static routes remain unchanged.
Changed source, configuration, specifications, documentation and report conform to repository formatting.
All 46 persistence tests, lint, Astro/type checks (27 files), and production build passed after utility extraction.

50 persistence tests passed, including blank summaries, whitespace preservation, malformed stored envelopes, and mismatched Registry associations. Lint, Astro/type checking and production build passed.

quality_gate.summary: Stops on five unrelated pre-existing formatting failures: .codex/skills/plancodechanges/SKILL.md and code_plans/blog_persistence/01-models-and-filesystem-adapter.md, 02-publication-cli-and-ingestion.md, 03-astro-runtime-integration.md, 04-browser-e2e-and-quality.md. These files were left unchanged. All remaining gate components passed when run explicitly.

integration.summary: Verified reopen, independent roots, live reader visibility around atomic commit, partial write cleanup, original/cleanup error retention, and exact stored bytes.
Outside Stage 1; reserved for subsequent approved stages.

remaining_issues: The full quality command remains red solely because of the five documented pre-existing formatting failures; no check was bypassed or weakened.
Whole-repository git diff --check also reports pre-existing trailing whitespace in blogpost-ideas.txt; that unrelated file was not changed.
Media checks identify formats by signatures rather than decoding complete images. Unsupported formats fail explicitly.
Publication assumes one writer and well-separated Registry timestamps. Crash recovery and power-loss durability remain outside scope.

handoff.recommended_next_action: Review Stage 1 implementation and resolve pre-existing formatting failures before proceeding to Stage 2 publication CLI and ingestion. No routes, baseline store, commits or deployments were created.
